data.name: Justinian
data.gender_notes: Justinian is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Iustinianus, derived from the Greek name Ioustinianos, meaning 'righteous, just, rule'. This name was borne by several emperors of the Eastern Roman Empire, including the renowned Emperor Justinian I (482-565 AD), who is known for his legal reforms and military conquests. The name Justinian carries the meaning “Righteous, just, rule” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Justinian usually hope their child will grow to embody righteous, just, rule and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes righteousness, justice, and rule in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Justinian belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Righteous, just, rule.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Justinian total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
